## ① Current PM

**Seated.** Account `os-tesla` (`get_me`) · session `session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW` · seated 2026-09-27T01:26Z on the maintainer's summon `/pm-dispatch spec@objectui`. Seat id `domain:spec#1` (unchanged from the predecessor's claims). Wake Routine `trig_01YZbb6oAmjLKurzQ77VszTC` (hourly, self-bound). Concurrency: **serial** from here on, one dev at a time. The maintainer's words in this session: 「当前任务处理完后，后续改为串行」. The work already in flight (#7924, #10770, PR #10791) finishes first; after that, one card is dispatched at a time. This supersedes 「并发保持3」. The predecessor, `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`, went off shift at 2026-09-25T04:25Z. Its ledger is the previous revision of this body. Ledger refreshed 2026-09-28T01:44Z.

## ② Ledger

**Gate.** NORTH-STAR 「优先级」 item 3 now reads the lane's own queue (objectstack-ai/objectstack#19980, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20009). This lane holds zero open P0/P1, so p2/p3 contract cards are dispatchable.

**R2 (maintainer: 「你不用下班，你可以继续派发。并发保持3」). Landing authorized in this session: 「授权本席落地:」 / 「我给你权限了」.**

  Only #7469 was closed, and `pm:dispatched` is removed.
- **MERGED in R2/R3**, each verified by content on `main`, with `pm:dispatched` removed and nothing else closed. The at-tier reviews were rendered by the director seat and read, head-checked and spot-checked by this seat:
  - #10584 → PR #10768 as `d89492c`: PASS `5856242218`, ACCEPT `5856253773`;

  - #10611 → PR #10760 as `17cc3a3`: delta PASS `5856250843`, ACCEPT `5856285587`.
- The dev report for #10584 carried an out-of-scope finding with a named producer. The seat filed it as **#10770**: the showcase `ObjectChart` react block's `series: [{ name }]` / `type` node is refused by `ObjectChartSchema`. It is not graded and not routed; that is triage's.
- #7924 → **back to the decision box** (`5855343256`: `needs-user-decision`, the claim released, `os-tesla` unassigned). Ruling A's own premise stop fired: `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:2401` is a second by-name relay hop of `densityMode` that the ruling does not name. Its only terminal consumer is the fold. The seat recommends A (both hops onto the fold). ⛔ The seat does not rule it.
- #7759 group C → **`pm:blocked`** (`5855376929`, `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20221` in the body, claim released).
  - The dev's Branch II measured `grid` / `inline` parsing green and rendering byte-identical to `vertical` on 7 surfaces, with 0 producers in three repos.
  - Per ruling `5617465269` principle 1 (zero pull ⇒ an objectstack enforce-or-remove card, blocked locally), the seat filed objectstack-ai/objectstack#20221 from the dev's draft. It is not graded and not routed.
- **R3** (the maintainer: 「你应该继续派其他任务啊」): the unlock sweep plus two measure-first dispatches.
  - #7928 and #7924 went to the box, and the director ruled both at 2026-09-27T14:24Z: #7924 **A′** `5856690997`, and #7928 **Q1 A · Q2 (i)** `5856694523`.

- **R4: 3 devs in flight.**
  - #7924 → `claude/issue-7924-density-mode-through-fold` (claim `5856715104`, ruling A′).
  - #10781 → `claude/issue-10781-fixture-citations` (claim `5856723117`). Test hygiene: the stale `data-protocol.ts` fixture citations the #10759 review flagged. `Clause-②: no`.
  - #10770 → `claude/issue-10770-object-chart-name-arm` (claim `5856718640`). The seat filed it from #10584's report, and triage graded it p3 at `5856177264`. It is measure-first, then aligns `ObjectChartSchema` with the spec's `{ name }` arm.
- #10781 → PR #10791 (head `a90af71878`). Comment-only in one test file; locus addendum `5856914139`. It touches none of the five review surfaces, so it needs the seat's read plus CI. CI is running.
- #10781 → PR #10791, **MERGED** as `dac022c` (ACCEPT `5856967370`). Verified by content on `main`, and `pm:dispatched` is removed.

On the dev's open question the seat chose B: the earlier pending changeset stays as written, and the new one states that it supersedes it.
- #8775 was ruled **B** by the maintainer (「8775 同意」, `5857078807`) and is back in `pm:queue`.
- #10770 → PR #10802 (draft, head `83f3e8662a`). `ObjectChartSchema` now takes the spec's `{ name }` arm and `specType` by reference, and a refinement requires one family. The dev measured that no runtime path runs the schema on the react-tier node. The at-tier review is ABSENT (`5857410146`, 429), and the PR carries `needs:contract-review`.
- #7928 → PR #10821 (draft, head `24bcb00353`, 24 files). It implements ruling Q1 A · Q2 (i). The at-tier review is ABSENT (`5858096304`, 429), and the PR carries `needs:contract-review`. The seat decided the dev's two questions: Q1 A (the strict kind blocks refuse nested non-protocol keys, within the ruled direction) and Q2 α (the doors keep their by-name pointers under `superRefine`).
- #10770 → PR #10802 at `77646f4150`, a merge of `main` only. **Correction:** the cancelled `Spec Main Shape Gate` was a degraded runner, not this PR. The patch round measured the whole-tree type-check as equal with and without the PR, and every step of the failed job, spec build included, ran 3–6× slow. The seat's wrong diagnosis `5857715528` was corrected at `5858943102`, and the PR body was corrected. The gate is green in 12.1 min and all CI is green. It still awaits the at-tier review (`needs:contract-review`).
- #8775 was ruled **B** (`5857078807`), and its execution parameter 6 routes it to the `domain:ui` seat. The seat's `pm:retriage` (`5858969456`) was answered, and the card now carries `domain:ui`. It is no longer this lane's.
- **Serial: no dev in flight.** No dispatchable card remains in the lane: #9828 waits for the tooling slot (#8071), and #4356 is not this seat's.
- **The director seat rendered at-tier records at 2026-09-27T23:47Z:**
  - PR #10793 (#7924): PASS `5860945101`. The seat spot-checked it and ACCEPTed (`5860950813`), then made the PR ready with auto-merge through the relay. #10821 must merge `main` after it lands, because they conflict in `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`.
  - PR #10780 (#10337): PASS `5860942003`. It is **Tier H**: it lands only on the maintainer's APPROVED review, with the director seat applying the four-piece. ⛔ The seat never approves or merges it.
  - PR #10802 (#10770): PASS `5860948115`. The director seat removed `needs:contract-review`, made it ready and enabled auto-merge (23:50–23:51Z). The seat spot-checked the record on the head and ACCEPTed (`5860980721`).
  - PR #10821 (#7928): PASS `5860951313` at `24bcb00353`. It conflicts with #10793 (`object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`) and with #10802 (`imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`). **Next serial step:** once both have merged, one dev runs a base-merge patch round; the director re-renders the at-tier record on the new head, and then it lands.

- #7928 → PR #10821, base-merge patch round (patch note `5861067908`, answering the director seat's landing sequence `5860984719`). The dev report is `5861421188`: head `395371dad2`, a merge of `main` `b956e693d0` plus one changeset re-point.
  - Both conflicts keep every assertion from both sides.
  - CI: 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 red. The Spec Main Shape Gate passed in 9.3 min.
  - `merge-tree` against `main` `fab627ff92` is clean.
  - The seat refreshed the PR body and handed off at `5861512467`.
  - The director seat's fresh record `5861705581` said PASS. The seat spot-checked it and ACCEPTed (`5861712995`).
  - **MERGED** as `b93e245f94`, verified by content on `main`: the changeset, 0 named-view `options` reads, the 17 tombstones, and both `IMPORTED` crossings. Only #7928 closed, and `pm:dispatched` is removed. The squash carries only a plain `Co-authored-by: Claude` trailer (0 model names).

It carries the boundary flags that records `5860945101`, `5860951313` and `5861705581` handed to the seat: pending changesets that #10793, #10802 and #10821 made false (`7924-named-list-view-retire`, `8355`, `10321`, `10584`, with the `options` nesting sentences of `8365`, `9242` and `8355` to be measured). It proposes dated supersession notes, `.changeset/*.md` only. Triage grades it; if it lands in this lane, it is the next serial dispatch. It has no file overlap with the open PR #10875.

## ④ Notes

- **Writes.** They go through the fleet-write relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- **Tier.** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is `claude-fable-5-1` (objectstack `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `16c5a33`). This seat is below tier, so every contract review runs as an isolated at-tier subagent.
- **`dispatch-gates` does not derive objectui.** It refuses objectui paths from the objectstack checkout (wrong-repo refusal). The gate list is hand-derived from objectui's own manifests and workflows, and the dev re-derives it against the actual diff.
- **Spec Main Shape Gate.** It compiles against objectstack `main`, not the pin.
